name: OOI Regional Cabled Array cable routes
description: Centerlines derived from NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' RSN Backbone Cable corridors (public domain US Gov data; 'For coastal and ocean planning', not for navigation) plus OOI node positions. Beyond the US EEZ, and the secondary cables at Axial, from M. Kidiwela, CascadiaEarthquakes ooi_cables.csv (https://github.com/MaleenKidiwela/CascadiaEarthquakes/blob/main/ooi_cables.csv).

properties.name: South backbone: Pacific City landfall -> PN1A (Slope Base)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Last ~0.46 km is a short stub from the corridor junction to the corridor terminus taken as PN1A.

properties.name: South backbone: PN1A (Slope Base) -> PN1B (Southern Hydrate Ridge)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis

properties.name: Extension: PN1B -> Southern Hydrate Ridge summit (LJ01B/MJ01B)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Corridor terminus coincides with RS01SUM1-LJ01B / RS01SUM2-MJ01B asset-management positions (<0.2 km).

properties.name: South backbone: PN1B -> PN1C (Oregon Offshore)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Split at the point on the corridor centerline closest to the COSZO PN01C ROV site (74 m off-line).

properties.name: South backbone: PN1C (Oregon Offshore) -> PN1D (Oregon Shelf)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Split at the point closest to the KCE-PN1D safety box centre (40 m off-line).

properties.name: Extension: PN1D -> Oregon Shelf MJ01C (80 m)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Corridor terminus coincides with CE02SHBP-MJ01C asset-management position.

properties.name: Unidentified RSN segment west of PN1A->PN1B leg (dead-end stub)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Present in the Marine Cadastre RSN corridor but role not documented (possibly spare/abandoned cable end, repair bight, or original lay). Not a confirmed live path.

properties.name: Unidentified short stub near PN1A->PN1B junction
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: 0.3 km stub; could be skeleton artefact of the corridor polygon or a short cable bight.

properties.name: North backbone: Pacific City landfall -> PN5A area (east junction)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis

properties.name: North backbone near PN5A: path A
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Corridor contains two roughly parallel cables between the east junction and the PN5A spur (in/out lay to the node or a repair re-lay); which is live is not documented.

properties.name: North backbone near PN5A: path B
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis

properties.name: Spur: backbone -> PN5A (Mid-Plate)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Corridor terminus matches the centre of the VAA-PN5A box on the OOI safety flyer (<0.1 km). Sub-100 m junction clutter between loop and spur omitted.

properties.name: North backbone: PN5A area -> US EEZ limit (toward PN3A)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Marine Cadastre geometry stops at the US EEZ boundary; cable continues to Axial Base (see approximate segment).

properties.name: Unidentified stub near PN5A (west)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Dead-end cable in the Marine Cadastre RSN corridor near PN5A; role not documented (possibly spare/abandoned end or future-expansion stub).

properties.name: Unidentified stub near PN5A (north-north-east)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis
properties.note: Dead-end cable in the Marine Cadastre RSN corridor near PN5A; role not documented (possibly spare/abandoned end or future-expansion stub).

properties.name: Pacific City cable landfall (both RCA lines)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506/508 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis (common landward terminus)
properties.note: Beach landfall; cables run underground north from a beach manhole to the shore station.

properties.name: RCA Shore Station, Pacific City, OR (approximate)
properties.source: Location stated by OOI/Interactive Oceans as Pacific City, OR; no published coordinates found - placed at the cable landfall
properties.note: Building is inland/north of the landfall via conduits; exact position not published (likely within ~1 km).

properties.name: PN1A (Slope Base)
properties.source: NOAA/BOEM Marine Cadastre 'Submarine Cable Areas' (SubmarineCable.gpkg, OBJECTID 506 'RSN Backbone Cable'); centerline derived from the ~61 m (200 ft) right-of-way corridor polygon by Voronoi medial axis; terminus of short stub at Slope Base corridor junction
properties.note: No published node coordinates. Within ~0.6 km of RS01SLBS-MJ01A (44.50988,-125.40524) from OOI asset-management.

properties.name: PN1B (Southern Hydrate Ridge)
properties.source: OOI safety flyer PC01A-LV01B-S2HR-PN1B: centre of KCE-PN1B box (44°28.48'-29.29'N, 125°08.33'-09.47'W); corroborated by COSZO cruise plan site PN01B 44°28.89'N 125°08.90'W, ~1249 m, and by MC corridor junction (<0.4 km)

properties.name: PN1C (Oregon Offshore)
properties.source: COSZO ship-time request (repo data/coszo, datamsri p.41) ROV site PN01C 44°21.82'N 124°57.72'W ~620 m; lies 74 m from the MC corridor centerline and inside the KCE-PN1C/LV01C polygon on the OOI safety flyer

properties.name: PN1D (Oregon Shelf)
properties.source: OOI safety flyer PN1C-PN1D-MPJ01C: centre of KCE-PN1D box (44°41.23'-41.73'N, 124°27.07'-27.77'W); corroborated by COSZO site PN01D 44°41.48'N 124°27.42'W ~113 m

properties.name: PN5A (Mid-Plate)
properties.source: OOI safety flyer PN3B-PC03A-PN5A: centre of VAA-PN5A box; matches MC corridor spur terminus

properties.name: PN3A (Axial Base) - approximate
properties.source: M. Kidiwela, CascadiaEarthquakes ooi_cables.csv: where the north backbone turns at Axial Base
properties.note: Placed where the north backbone turns at Axial Base in ooi_cables.csv (M. Kidiwela); the MJ03A junction box is ~0.5 km away.

properties.name: PN3B (Axial Caldera / ASHES) - approximate
properties.source: OOI safety flyer PN3B-PC03A-PN5A: centre of VAA-PN3B box (a ~2 x 2.5 nm avoidance area, not the node itself)
properties.note: Node lies somewhere inside the VAA box (±2 km); box covers ASHES/International District/Eastern caldera.

properties.note: Vertices are sparse beyond the EEZ (up to ~50 km apart); the route bows north of a straight line by up to ~13 km.
